# Digifab Quoting

Compact LLM context index for this repository.

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md` — canonical agent operating instructions.
- `README.md` — human/product overview when present.
- `ECOSYSTEM.md` — MADFAM ecosystem and Enclii deployment context when present.
- `llms-full.txt` — full context map and durable operating contract.

## Production operations

Routine production operations are Enclii-first. Use Enclii web, API, or CLI
before raw infrastructure tools. Direct `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs,
`docker exec`, or direct container access is bootstrap/break-glass only.

## What this repo is

Cotiza Studio: multi-tenant quoting for digital fabrication (3D printing,
CNC, laser) and services. pnpm/turbo monorepo: `apps/api` (NestJS 10 +
Prisma), `apps/web` (Next.js 15.5 App Router), `apps/worker` (Python FastAPI
geometry/DFM), `packages/pricing-engine`, `packages/shared`, `packages/ui`.

## Key docs

- `ROADMAP.md` — the single pending-work list (priorities, owner decision vs engineering) and the Yantra4D quote-import waves.
- `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` — current deploy path (Enclii `build-publish.yml@v1.0.0-alpha.9` → GHCR → digest pin in `infra/k8s/production/kustomization.yaml` → ArgoCD).
- `AGENTS.md` "Current state" — stack, CI gates, known test gaps, related repositories and contracts.
- `docs/ROUTES.md`, `docs/API_REFERENCE.md` — API surface.

## Facts that are easy to get wrong

- Deploys come from two callers, `Build & Deploy` (api, web, worker) and `Deploy API Only` (api on `ubuntu-24.04`); they share one concurrency group.
- GitHub-hosted jobs are pinned to `ubuntu-24.04`, not `ubuntu-latest`.
- `@cotiza/pricing-engine` tests are all excluded in its `jest.config.js`; the worker and web app have no unit tests.
- nodemailer stays on 6.x until the email transport moves to SESv2; `test.yml` (manual-only) still uses the retired `upload-artifact@v3`.
- Janua is identity, Dhanam is billing, Karafiel is CFDI, Pravara is fabrication dispatch. Cotiza's Pravara dispatch path and Dhanam milestone-invoice path currently drift from the other side's routes (see `AGENTS.md` and `ROADMAP.md`).
